title: platformer
shortDescription: A kung-fu fighter against red, blue and green goblins on a Turrican backdrop — Aseprite sheets, one-shot kicks, Flip, Anchor, Fade, Flash and PaletteSwap
description:
A side-scrolling kung-fu fight in pixel art. Keys: **←/→** walk, **↑** or **space** a flying kick, **K** a kick; without keys an autoplay fights.

**Aseprite import.** The fighter and the goblin are Aseprite sheets, plain atlas items of a `TextureStore` catalog: the store reads `meta.app` of the json and turns the frame tags into the `frameBasedAnimations` of the item, per-frame durations included — the held frame of the kick lasts 320 ms, the others 70 to 110. `idle` plays in ping-pong and `walk` in a loop as the tags say; `kick`, `flying-kick`, `hit`, `attack` and `die` are one-shots: their tags carry Aseprite's *Repeat* of 1, which the built-in adapter reads as `playback: 'once'`. A one-shot starts with `animOffset = -now` and ends after `animation(name).cycleDuration`, holding its last frame; a strike lands only while its held key frame is on screen, and its reach is the trimmed frame itself. See [Animated frames](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#animated-frames) and [Aseprite sheets](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#aseprite-sheets).

**`Flip` and `Anchor`.** Both sheets face right; `Flip` mirrors every frame the animsMap picks, trim margins included — the fighter marks a turn with `touchVO(sprite, 'flip')`, the goblins carry `attributeUsage: {dynamic: ['flip']}`. `setAnchorFromPivot()` reads the `pivot` slice, the pixel under the feet, so the trimmed frames stand on the floor whatever their size. *flip* and *anchor* switch both off. See [Flip](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#flip) and [Anchor](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#anchor).

**`Fade` and `Flash`.** A kick flashes a goblin white, a club flashes the fighter red; a defeated goblin lies still, fades out, and a new one fades in elsewhere. See [Fade and flash](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#fade-and-flash).

**`PaletteSwap`.** One olive goblin sheet, drawn red, blue and green by the `paletteRow` of each sprite in `goblin-palette.png`; the textures load with `nearest` filtering, as the exact colour match needs. *palette swap* draws them all in row 0. See [Palette swap and colour cycling](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/sprites.md#palette-swap-and-colour-cycling).

The camera is orthographic and draws one art pixel as a whole number of device pixels; it follows the fighter, and the sky, the crags and the machine city scroll behind at 0.05, 0.25 and 0.5 of its pace. The assets are generated by `apps/lookbook/assets-src/platformer/`.
